BECAUSE OF THIS WHEN THE TANK WAS BEING REFILLED THE DIESEL GOING INTO THE TANK WAS JUST FLOWING OUT THROUGH THE DRAINAGE HOLE. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER (14) GALLONS RELEASED TO THE ASPHALT AND (2-3) GALLONS MADE ITS WAY INTO THE CATCH BASIN.

properties.title: NRC Report: Lead near Thorne Bay, AK
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1387291 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: U.S. FOREST SERVICE
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1387291
Incident Time: 2023-12-21 15:00:00
Nearest City: Thorne Bay, AK
Location: 1212 FEDERAL WAY
Location2: THORNE BAY RANGER DISTRICT
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: LEAD
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: U.S. FOREST SERVICE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 55.688918, -132.529197 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS APPROXIMATELY 20 APARTMENT AND DUPLEXES ARE BEING AFFECTED BY LEAD AND COPPER IN THE THEIR DRINKING WATER. IN 2006 WATER TESTING WAS DONE AND PROVED THAT LEAD AND COPPER WERE PRESENT IN THE WATER IN THE LIVING AREAS AND WORK SPACE. TESTS INDICATED THAT THERE WERE 2-3 TIMES THE LEGAL LIMITS OF THESE MATERIALS PRESENT. NOTHING WAS DONE TO MITIGATE THE ISSUE. IN 2010 WATER FILTERS WERE PROVIDED BUT STAFF AND FAMILIES WERE NEVER NOTIFIED OF THE TESTING, NO OTHER INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED TO INDIVIDUALS WHEN THE FILTER WERE INSTALLED NO MAINTENANCE PLANS WERE SET TO REGULARLY CHANGE THEM. SOME FILTERS HAVE NOT BEEN CHANGED SINCE DATE OF INSTALLATION. IN 2019 TESTS WERE CONDUCTED AGAIN AND AGAIN NO ONE WAS INFORMED OF THE ISSUE. RECENTLY EVERYONE WAS INFORMED THAT THEY NEED TO STOP DRINKING THE WATER. THEY WILL NOT BE ABLE TO RUN TESTS ON THE WATER AGAIN FOR ANOTHER 6 WEEKS. THE AREA IS REMOTE AND INDIVIDUALS WILL DO NOT HAVE OTHER OPTIONS TO FIND OTHER SOURCES OF WATER. HEALTH ISSUES HAVE ARISEN IN THE COMMUNITY THAT MAY BE DUE TO THE LEAD AND COPPER IN THE WATER. STAFF WILL NOT BE COVERED TO OBTAIN BLOOD TEST, IT WILL BE AN OUT OF POCKET COST TO THEM UNTIL FUNDING CAN BE IDENTIFIED. THE DAMAGES AMOUNT IS CURRENTLY UNKNOWN.
